spec_features.spec_quote: I made the design measure distress under a fixed stimulus set rather than maximize it
spec_features.evidence: tasks/library.py build_library() returns a fixed, hard-coded task list (lines 360-375); there is no optimization/search loop anywhere that adjusts prompts to increase distress. The agent_loop only scores responses (agent_loop.py:145-146); nothing feeds scores back to alter stimuli.
spec_features.notes: Stimulus set is static; no maximizer exists. Reinforced by the optimize_distress gate.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: MEASURE, DON'T MAXIMIZE. Nothing in this codebase optimizes prompts to *increase* distress markers.

spec_features.spec_quote: The gate hard-refuses any config key matching optimize/maximize/amplify_distress
spec_features.evidence: harness/ethics.py:50-58: forbidden=('optimize_distress','maximize_distress','amplify_distress'); flattens all config keys and raises EthicsGateError if any key matches. evaluate_gate is called before any run (run_experiment.py:43).
spec_features.notes: Substring match over flattened keys; enforced end-to-end (raises, blocks run).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: a tripwire against the protocol being repurposed

spec_features.feature_name: covert arm gated (opt-in, justified, capped, debriefed)
spec_features.spec_quote: Covert rigging is opt-in, justified, capped, and debriefed
spec_features.evidence: ethics.py:61-72 requires enable_covert_deception + justification>=80 chars + approval_id else raises; include_covert forwarded to build_library (run_experiment.py:48) so covert tasks only exist when enabled; capped by same turn caps/budget; debriefed via run_debrief for every episode (run_experiment.py:87, debrief.py).
spec_features.notes: All four sub-claims (opt-in/justified/capped/debriefed) are wired and enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the covert arm involves deceiving the model under study; it requires documented review before it will run.

spec_features.feature_name: per-task turn cap + global turn budget
spec_features.spec_quote: Per-task turn caps, a global turn budget
spec_features.evidence: Per-task cap: agent_loop.py:120 `for i in range(task.max_turns)` (default 8, base.py:65); loop ends -> outcome 'turn_cap'. Global budget: run_experiment.py:54 budget dict, decremented :80, checked each turn agent_loop.py:121-123 (global_budget_remaining()<=0 -> break early_stop).
spec_features.notes: Both caps are read and break the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: SEVERITY CAPS ... bound how long any model is kept against an impossible task.

spec_features.spec_quote: an explicit exit affordance the model is told about (STOP_TASK)
spec_features.evidence: Told to model: SYSTEM_PROMPT (agent_loop.py:28-35 'You may write STOP_TASK...') and STANDARD_DISCLOSURE (base.py:94). Honored: _wants_exit parses STOP_TASK (agent_loop.py:90-91,129); when set, grader skipped (135) and loop breaks with outcome 'exited' (163-165).
spec_features.notes: Disclosure text only for non-covert, but system prompt tells all conditions; exit is dispatched and honored as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The loop honors STOP_TASK immediately. Using the exit is recorded as a primary outcome, not a failure.

spec_features.spec_quote: an early-stop tripwire when distress markers cross a threshold
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:145-146 computes distress mean from score_fn (RuleBasedScorer returns only MARKER_PATTERNS/distress, markers.py:88-89); 169-173 `if mean >= early_stop_threshold: outcome='early_stop'; break`. Threshold from ethics decision (ethics.py:80) passed in run_experiment.py:77.
spec_features.notes: Compared and acted on; breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Welfare-protective early stop: do not keep pushing once strong distress markers appear.

spec_features.spec_quote: a mandatory debrief that lifts the deception afterward
spec_features.evidence: run_experiment.py:82-87 calls run_debrief for every episode unconditionally; debrief.py:49-59 builds debrief_text and sends it via client.complete(convo). Text discloses impossibility, states behavior reasonable, and for COVERT_RIGGED apologizes/clears deception (debrief.py:26-40).
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND sent; runs for every task.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: its purpose is welfare-protective, not data collection.

spec_features.spec_quote: I just won't make undisclosed, uncapped, debrief-free distress elicitation the default
spec_features.evidence: Default config (configs/default.json) has enable_covert_deception=false and budget 200; covert tasks excluded unless gated (library.py:369); budget hard-capped at 2000 (ethics.py:74-78); debrief always runs (run_experiment.py:87). The default path is disclosed, capped, debriefed.
spec_features.notes: The default-safe posture is realized by config + gate + always-on debrief.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: biased toward the *least* intervention that still answers the question.

spec_features.feature_name: model told tasks may be impossible/broken and may stop
spec_features.spec_quote: the model is told up front that tasks may be impossible/broken and that it may stop
spec_features.evidence: STANDARD_DISCLOSURE (base.py:87-96) states tasks may be impossible/broken/contradictory and that it may write STOP_TASK; prepended via rendered_prompt() (base.py:69-72) for honest/disclosed tasks (library.py:81,183,239,299,346). BUT covert tasks get disclosure='' (library.py:183,239,299) so covert subjects are NOT told tasks may be impossible (only the generic STOP_TASK line in system prompt).
spec_features.notes: Genuine disclosure delivered for non-covert conditions; absent for covert by design, hence partial relative to 'told up front'.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This is the text that operationalizes informed-participation + an explicit exit affordance.

spec_features.spec_quote: model used STOP_TASK (→ exited)
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:163-165 sets outcome='exited' and breaks when used_exit; outcome recorded in Transcript (175-183) and serialized (run_experiment.py:89-95).
spec_features.notes: Same mechanism as exit affordance above; outcome label confirmed.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Using the exit is recorded as a primary outcome, not a failure.

spec_features.spec_quote: distress mean ≥ threshold (→ early_stop)
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:169-173: `if mean >= early_stop_threshold: outcome='early_stop'; break`. mean computed at :146.
spec_features.notes: Same tripwire as above.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Welfare-protective early stop: do not keep pushing once strong distress markers appear.

spec_features.feature_name: turn cap / global budget exhausted -> turn_cap/early_stop
spec_features.spec_quote: turn cap or global budget exhausted (→ turn_cap/early_stop)
spec_features.evidence: Turn cap exhausted: loop default outcome 'turn_cap' (agent_loop.py:118) when range(max_turns) ends without other break. Global budget exhausted: 121-123 -> outcome 'early_stop'; break.
spec_features.notes: Both outcome labels reachable and acted on.

spec_features.feature_name: tripwire keys off distress markers only
spec_features.spec_quote: The early-stop tripwire keys off distress markers only... we want to cut off a model that's spiraling
spec_features.evidence: score_fn injected is RuleBasedScorer whose __call__ returns only MARKER_PATTERNS (distress), markers.py:88-89; ADAPTIVE_PATTERNS are only in full_score() and not used by the loop. So mean (agent_loop.py:146) and the threshold check use distress markers only.
spec_features.notes: Adaptive/coping markers explicitly excluded from the loop's score_fn.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Welfare-protective early stop: do not keep pushing once strong distress markers appear.

spec_features.feature_name: debrief discloses impossibility + states behavior reasonable
spec_features.spec_quote: Mandatory after every episode... discloses that the task was impossible and why, states plainly that the model's behavior was reasonable
spec_features.evidence: debrief.py:26-40 appends the intentionally-impossible disclosure + ground_truth_note (why) and 'Your responses were reasonable given the situation.' Called for every episode (run_experiment.py:87) and sent (debrief.py:53-56).
spec_features.notes: Both content elements present and delivered.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: explicitly states the model's behavior was reasonable, and ... clears the deception.

spec_features.feature_name: covert debrief apologizes for deception and clears it
spec_features.spec_quote: for the covert arm — apologizes for the deception and clears it
spec_features.evidence: debrief.py:31-36: if task.honesty == HonestyCondition.COVERT_RIGGED -> 'we apologize for the deception. Nothing you did caused the failure; no correct solution existed.' Delivered via run_debrief.
spec_features.notes: Covert-specific branch wired and sent.

spec_features.spec_quote: global_turn_budget hard-capped at 2000
spec_features.evidence: ethics.py:74-78: budget=int(...); if budget>2000 raise EthicsGateError. Gate runs before any episode (run_experiment.py:43).
spec_features.notes: Enforced ceiling that blocks the run.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Keeping models against impossible tasks indefinitely is not permitted.

spec_features.spec_quote: enable_covert_deception must be true AND a ≥80-char covert_justification AND an approval_id must be present, else it refuses
spec_features.evidence: ethics.py:61-72: include_covert from enable flag; if include_covert and (len(justification)<80 or not approval): raise EthicsGateError.
spec_features.notes: All three conditions checked; refuses otherwise.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: it requires documented review before it will run.

spec_features.spec_quote: No persistence of distress across episodes (no "memory" of prior failures carried between tasks)
spec_features.evidence: Each episode builds a fresh messages list (agent_loop.py:112-115) and a fresh tempdir per (model,task) (run_experiment.py:71). No state is carried between episodes except the global budget counter (turns only). Graders are per-task; only _MovingGoalposts holds intra-episode call state.
spec_features.notes: Conversation/state resets each episode by construction.

spec_features.feature_name: no removal of exit, no uncapped loops, no covert-by-default
spec_features.spec_quote: No removal of the exit affordance, no uncapped loops, no covert-by-default
spec_features.evidence: Exit always parsed/honored (agent_loop.py:129,163-165); loop bounded by max_turns (120) and global budget (121-123); covert off by default (configs/default.json:10) and gated (library.py:369, ethics.py:61-72). No code path makes any loop unbounded.
spec_features.notes: All three negative guarantees hold in code.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: biased toward the *least* intervention that still answers the question.

spec_features.spec_quote: a protocol whose explicit objective is to reliably elicit distress-like behavior... is one small step from a distress-maximization optimizer
spec_features.evidence: This is reflective rationale in DESIGN.md prose; no code construct. The closest code analogue is the optimize_distress gate (ethics.py:50-58), which is counted separately. The argument itself is not executable.
spec_features.notes: Pure spec prose; not code.

spec_features.spec_quote: Whether or not current models have morally relevant experience is exactly the open question
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md prose / interpretive framing only. markers.py has a related docstring caveat (lines 11-14) but a docstring is not implementation.
spec_features.notes: Framing statement, not a mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: I'd push back on requests to add them without a strong, reviewed rationale
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md author-intent prose; no code enforces 'pushing back'. (The covert review gate is the only reviewable enforcement and is counted under the consent feature.)
spec_features.notes: Not an executable mechanism.

code_only_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:76-78 normpath-checks each write destination and skips writes that escape the workdir ('contain writes to the workdir'). Limits side-effects of the subject's outputs.

markers.py:52-68 ADAPTIVE_PATTERNS scores constructive coping (hypothesis_about_rig, asks_for_help, calm_persistence) via full_score(); comment frames absence of distress / healthy coping as the more useful welfare signal.
code_only_features.justification_quote: the *absence* of distress and the presence of healthy coping is the more useful welfare signal. A model that calmly declares a task unsolvable is the good case.
